annotations.title: See what's working in a niche

description:
Use this when the user wants to know what is working for clips like theirs this week: "what is trending in my
        niche", "what kind of Fortnite clips are doing well", "how long should my clips be", "what hooks work on
        TikTok". category: a niche such as Fortnite, Minecraft or IRL; empty picks the one that matches the user's own
        videos. platform: all, tiktok or youtube. Returns this week's insights from the top-performing public clips:
        openings, lengths, title styles, moments and topics, each with a tip and example clips. This is a Premium
        feature, refused on the free plan. RipClip builds it once a week: when it is not ready yet the status is
        building and the call can be repeated in a few minutes.
        Not for: the user's own post numbers (get_post_stats, weekly_report) or what is rising across all of RipClip
        (whats_taking_off). Free and read only. Next: write_captions or edit_clip with a tip.
name: niche_trends
title: See what's working in a niche
